info.title: How to use Time Planner
info.intro: This page helps you plan work, track time, and remember your breaks.
info.section.overviewStep1: In Settings, enter your projects (number or description from company timesheet tool) and tasks (e.g., CTASK from ServiceNow) according to the names used in your company.
info.section.overviewStep2: Enter the number of worked hours or use Pomodoro mode to calculate them automatically.
info.section.overviewStep3: Click 'Add entry' to save your time in the table below.
info.section.overviewStep4: Use the toggles above the form to show or hide the sections you need.
info.section.overviewStep5: The entries list shows all tasks – you can filter them by date, task type, and project.
info.section.overviewStep6: The 'Export data' button downloads a CSV file with hours from the current month.
info.section.overviewStep7: The red button with trash icon in the top left corner allows you to delete all entries at once. This operation requires confirmation and is irreversible.
info.section.pomodoroIntro: The Pomodoro timer helps you work in short, focused cycles.
info.section.pomodoroStep1: Click the 🍅 icon to expand the widget, complete all fields and press Start to begin the countdown.
info.section.pomodoroStep2: When manually finishing work, click 'Complete task' (green checkmark), a notification about adding the entry will be displayed if the task duration is at least 30 minutes.
info.section.pomodoroStep3: The entry is added automatically to the list.
info.section.pomodoroStep4: Subsequent sessions with the same task number or name will append time to the existing entry, so you keep the full history.
info.section.pomodoroNote: When a session finishes, you do not have to add the task manually – the app does it for you and remembers the hours you gather in later pomodoros.
info.section.monthEndNote: The month-end warning is to remind you to enter all hours into the appropriate company time tracking tools.
info.section.todoIntro: The To-Do widget helps gather quick tasks next to the timer.
info.section.todoStep1: Click the 📋 icon to expand the widget and fill in the description, priority, and due date (or check 'No date') to add a task.
info.section.todoStep2: Drag items to change their order within sections.
info.section.todoStep3: The '✓', '✕', and '→' buttons next to a task add the number/name to the corresponding field in the 'Add new entry' section, remove it, or send the number to Pomodoro to start the timer. The task will automatically disappear from To-Do when all remaining fields in 'Add new entry' are filled and after confirming with the 'Add entry' button.
